components.name: ImageGeneration
components.doc: A card for one image request. While the image is being made, a field of cells shimmers behind a progress line and a phase label; when it is ready the image resolves from blurred to sharp and the footer turns into the actions: regenerate, download, copy prompt.

members.name: prompt
members.doc: The prompt the image was requested with.

members.name: src
members.doc: Address of the finished image. It is shown when the status is "done".

members.name: alt
members.doc: Alternative text of the finished image. Defaults to the prompt.

members.name: status
members.doc: Where the request is (controlled). Leave it out and the card runs a timed preview: `duration` of progress on mount and on every regenerate.

members.name: progress
members.doc: Progress from 0 to 1 while generating (controlled, used together with `status`).

members.name: duration
members.doc: Length of the built-in timed preview in milliseconds, when `status` is not controlled.

members.name: model
members.doc: Name of the model or style, shown next to the prompt.

members.name: aspectRatio
members.doc: Aspect ratio of the image frame, as a CSS `aspect-ratio` value.

members.name: error
members.doc: Message shown when the status is "error".

members.name: onRegenerate
members.doc: Called by Generate, Regenerate and Try again. Swap `src` here to show a new result.

members.name: onComplete
members.doc: Called when the built-in timed preview reaches the end.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.
